label: slumberreset3
title_zh: 2020 年 12 月 28 日（黏土与发条）

lines.en: label slumberreset3:
I send a quick text message to both Maya and Ayane about my success with our {i}targets.{/i}
lines.zh: 我给 Maya 和 Ayane 各发了一条短信，告诉她们我在我们的{i}目标{/i}那边成功了。

lines.en: Whether that success will lead to anything long-lasting is still up in the air, but at least I’ve managed to overcome adversity and actually be {i}useful{/i} in some form for once.
lines.zh: 这份成功能不能带来什么持久的东西还不好说，但至少我克服了逆境，总算以某种形式真的{i}有用{/i}了一回。

lines.en: It only took...I don’t know- how long has it been again?
lines.zh: 只不过花了……我不知道——又过了多久来着？

lines.en: A year?
lines.zh: 一年？

lines.en: Two?
lines.zh: 两年？

lines.en: Three?
lines.zh: 三年？

lines.en: It’s surprisingly hard to keep track of time without an annually increased four-digit number that serves to constantly remind you of how many years you’ve been alive.
lines.zh: 没有那个每年加一、时刻提醒你活了多少年的四位数，时间意外地难记。

lines.en: Throughout my time here (However long it may be), that number has only gone up once- and even then it was only for a short while as the new year rolled in on deflated tires and a misshapen axle.
lines.zh: 在我待在这儿的这段时间里（不管有多长），那个数字只涨过一次——而且即便如此，也只是短暂地涨了一下，因为新年是瘪着轮胎、歪着车轴滚进来的。

lines.en: Today is December 28th, 2020.
lines.zh: 今天是 2020 年 12 月 28 日。

lines.en: Or is it?
lines.zh: 还是吗？

lines.en: Ask me again if your calendar ever runs out of pages.
lines.zh: 等你的日历哪天翻完了页，再问我一遍。

lines.en: A text arrives just before I fall too deep into confusing introspection.
lines.zh: 在我陷进令人困惑的自省之前，一条短信到了。

lines.en: And as I pull myself from a well shaped by bricks of clay and clockwork, I wonder if the light of day will ever return.
lines.zh: 而当我把自己从一口由黏土砖和发条砌成的井里拉出来时，我在想，日光还会不会回来。

lines.en: I wonder when I’ll run out of pages.
lines.zh: 我在想，我什么时候会耗尽页数。

lines.en: scene sky
: {i}Can I call you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我能给你打电话吗？{/i}

lines.en: This is not the correct light.
lines.zh: 这不是正确的光。

lines.en: It doesn’t hurt when I look up.
lines.zh: 我抬头看的时候，它并不刺痛。

lines.en: : {i}Sure.{/i}
Or maybe I’m already a little blind.
lines.zh: 也许我已经有点瞎了。

lines.en: : Hey! Good to see you’re using your normal phone again.
lines.zh: : 嘿！很高兴看到你又在用你自己的手机了。

lines.en: I answer before it even has a chance to ring.
lines.zh: 它在响之前我就接了。

lines.en: The voice on the other end makes the day a little brighter, but it still doesn’t hurt.
lines.zh: 电话那头的声音让这一天亮了一点，但它依然不刺痛。

lines.en: : You really got Yumi and Tsuneyo on board? Like, seriously? How did that go?
lines.zh: : 你真的把 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 拉进来了？说真的？过程怎么样？

lines.en: : Ayane...is Todd still missing?
lines.zh: : Ayane……Todd 还失踪着吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Yeah. You haven’t seen him, have you?
lines.zh: : 嗯？对啊。你没见过他，对吧？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : No, I haven’t. I was just wondering.
lines.zh: : 没有，我没见过。我只是随口问问。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay! Tell me more about what happened, though. Was it hard? How much were you able to say about stuff?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧！不过多跟我说说发生了什么。难吗？你到底能说多少？

lines.en: : You’re on speaker, by the way. Maya’s here.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，你开着免提。Maya 在这儿。

lines.en: : That’s fine. It wasn’t {i}particularly{/i} hard. I needed a different approach for each of them, but...we should be able to move forward now. Wherever forward {i}is{/i} exactly.
lines.zh: : 没关系。{i}不算特别{/i}难。她们每个人我都需要不同的方法，不过……我们现在应该能往前推进了。不管「往前」{i}是{/i}哪儿。

lines.en: : I think forward means backward right now, but that’s still great news. Have you given them your new address yet?
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在往前就是往后，不过这也是好消息。你把新地址给她们了吗？

lines.en: : I haven’t even given {i}you{/i} my new address yet.
lines.zh: : 我连{i}你{/i}都还没给过我的新地址。

lines.en: : You should hurry up and do that. Maya says the thing might happen any day now.
lines.zh: : 你该赶紧给。Maya 说那件事可能随时发生。

lines.en: : It’s true. The sooner we get this out of the way, the better.
lines.zh: : 没错。越早把这事办完越好。

lines.en: : As you know, I’m unable to pinpoint the exact date this will happen-
lines.zh: : 如你所知，我没法精确指出这会发生在哪一天-

lines.en: : But a prolonged delay puts everything you’ve done over the last two days at risk. Which would be a shame since you finally, you know, {i}did{/i} something. We don’t want that to go to waste.
lines.zh: : 但拖得太久，会让你这两天做的所有事都面临白费的风险。那可就太可惜了，因为你终于，你知道的，{i}做了{/i}点什么。我们不想让它白费。

lines.en: : It’s also very likely this “slumber party” may need a bit of an extension if the reset does not fall on the first night of our get-together.
lines.zh: : 而且如果重置没有落在我们聚会的第一个晚上，这场「睡衣派对」很可能还得延长。

lines.en: : I vote that we all move in with Sensei until the world ends!
lines.zh: : 我提议我们全都搬去跟 Sensei 住，直到世界末日！

lines.en: : Rejected. There’s no way that would work when-
lines.zh: : 驳回。那绝对行不通，因为-

lines.en: : When are we doing this?
lines.zh: : 我们什么时候办？

lines.en: There’s a brief silence on the other end of the phone when I attempt to move things along.
lines.zh: 我试图推进事情的时候，电话那头出现了短暂的沉默。

lines.en: It’s a safe bet that neither Ayane nor Maya expected me to interject in such a way given how laid-back I typically am in the face of what could only be described as “certain doom...”
lines.zh: 面对这只能用「必然的末日」来形容的局面，我平时一向很随性，所以可以肯定 Ayane 和 Maya 都没料到我会这样插话。

lines.en: But there are things I’m worried about losing now.
lines.zh: 但现在有些东西我是怕失去的。

lines.en: You see, I had another dream last night.
lines.zh: 你看，我昨晚又做了个梦。

lines.en: They’re happening almost every time I fall asleep.
lines.zh: 现在几乎每次睡着都会做。

lines.en: But they never help.
lines.zh: 但它们从来帮不上忙。

lines.en: All they do is dangle the things I’m learning to love in front of my face- then mock me when they cut the string.
lines.zh: 它们所做的，只是把我渐渐学会去爱的东西吊在我眼前——然后剪断绳子，嘲笑我。

lines.en: Yet somehow...
lines.zh: 然而不知怎么的……

lines.en: Nothing falls but me.
lines.zh: 掉下来的只有我。

lines.en: : We...need a bit more time to make the necessary “preparations” first. I’m sure the other two girls would also appreciate being given some sort of notice.
lines.zh: : 我们……还需要一点时间做必要的「准备」。我想另外两个女孩也会希望提前得到点通知。

lines.en: : What sort of “preparations” need to be made, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体要做什么样的「准备」？

lines.en: : Maya hasn’t figured out what to do about Ami yet.
lines.zh: : Maya 还没想好 Ami 怎么办。

lines.en: : It’s been a very long time since I’ve needed to do something like this and, somehow, she seems even {i}more{/i} attached to you now. Which I suppose would make sense given how...you know.
lines.zh: : 我很久没需要做这种事了，而且不知怎么的，她现在似乎对你{i}更{/i}黏了。考虑到……你知道的，这倒也说得通。

lines.en: : But it doesn’t change the fact that I’m having a difficult time shaking her as the absence of {i}all three of us{/i} is sure to set off some alarms in that mostly-empty head of hers.
lines.zh: : 但这改变不了一个事实：我很难把她甩开——我们{i}三个{/i}同时缺席，肯定会在她那颗基本空荡荡的脑袋里拉响警报。

lines.en: : That’s true...she {i}has{/i} been feeling awfully left out lately.
lines.zh: : 这倒是真的……她最近{i}确实{/i}觉得自己被冷落得厉害。

lines.en: : She looks up to Niki a lot. I could ask her if-
lines.zh: : 她很崇拜 Niki。我可以问问她能不能-

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Wow. That was an uncharacteristically snappy response.
lines.zh: : 哇。这反应快得不像你。

lines.en: : I can handle Ami. I just need a little more time. Two days at the most.
lines.zh: : Ami 我来搞定。我只是需要多一点时间。最多两天。

lines.en: : Then let’s shoot for Sunday. Abandoning her on New Year's Eve sounds even harder since it’s a holiday, but the day before would probably be doable, right?
lines.zh: : 那就定在周日。除夕丢下她听起来更难，毕竟是节日，不过前一天大概可行，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s probably our best bet, yes. I just hope everything lasts until then as we’re already cutting it close.
lines.zh: : 那大概是我们最好的选择，对。我只希望一切能撑到那时候，因为我们已经很赶了。

lines.en: : Does that work for you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你这边可以吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ll tell the others now. And if you need any help with Ami-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我现在就去告诉其他人。要是你需要帮忙处理 Ami-

lines.en: : Absolutely, under no circumstances, do {i}anything{/i} about Ami. If you get involved, she’ll just wind up being more suspicious.
lines.zh: : 绝对、无论如何都{i}不要{/i}对 Ami 做任何事。你要是掺和进来，她只会更起疑心。

lines.en: : What should I do then? I don’t want to just wait around.
lines.zh: : 那我该做什么？我不想就这么干等着。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll figure it out. But, seeing as we have now exhausted everything we needed to talk about, I’ll be hanging up now.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会想出来的。不过，既然我们已经把该谈的都谈完了，我要挂了。

lines.en: : Wait, Maya! That’s my-
lines.zh: : 等等，Maya！那是我的-

lines.en: scene black
For the next two days, I do nothing.
lines.zh: 接下来的两天，我什么都没做。

lines.en: I don’t leave my house...or respond to any text messages from anyone unrelated to the upcoming reset...
lines.zh: 我没有出门……也没有回复任何与即将到来的重置无关的人的短信……

lines.en: And some of them probably worry about me.
lines.zh: 她们中有些人大概会担心我。

lines.en: They {i}all{/i} probably worry about me since I’ve somehow wound up as the anchor keeping them planted on this planet, but...
lines.zh: 她们{i}全都会{/i}担心我，因为我不知怎么成了把她们钉在这颗星球上的锚，可是……

lines.en: They shouldn’t.
lines.zh: 她们不该这样。

lines.en: I’m fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: I’m fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: $ totaldays += 2
$ day = 7
show sunday
scene resetslumber1
The night of the slumber party comes before I know it.
lines.zh: 睡衣派对的那晚，在我意识到之前就到了。

lines.en: Yumi and Tsuneyo both showed up precisely when they were supposed to, and Ayane wound up convincing Sana to invite Ami over to her dorm room for a gaming-focused sleepover.
lines.zh: Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 都在该到的时间准时出现，而 Ayane 说服了 Sana 把 Ami 请到她的宿舍房间，办一个以打游戏为主的通宵派对。

lines.en: Apparently, Ami was a little hesitant at first given that Sana had never done something like that before, but...
lines.zh: 听说 Ami 起初有点犹豫，因为 Sana 从来没做过这种事，不过……

lines.en: I guess she is {i}my{/i} niece after all. And I’d never be able to refuse Sana if she asked me to do something like that.
lines.zh: 我想她毕竟是{i}我{/i}的[niece]。要是 Sana 开口要我做类似的事，我也绝不会拒绝。

lines.en: In fact, I {i}hope{/i} she asks me to do something like that. A two-person sleepover with a girl like her is all someone like me could ever...
lines.zh: 事实上，我{i}希望{/i}她开口要我做类似的事。跟她那样的女孩两个人一起过夜，是我这种人能……

lines.en: Could ever...
Nevermind.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I’m not in the mood.
lines.zh: 我没那个心情。

lines.en: : So, uhh...thanks to everyone for coming! I know that neither of you are particularly close to any of us and that...this probably sounded kind of insane when you first heard about it, but...uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……谢谢大家能来！我知道你们俩跟我们谁都不算特别亲近，而且……你们刚听说这事的时候大概觉得挺疯的，不过……呃……

lines.en: : There’s pizza? And other assorted snacks and stuff. So it doesn’t have to be, like...{i}completely{/i} awkward...right?
lines.zh: : 有披萨。还有各种零食什么的。所以也不至于……{i}完全{/i}尴尬……对吧？

lines.en: : Nah. This shit’s even more wack than I thought it was gonna be.
lines.zh: : 不。这破事比我想的还要离谱。

lines.en: scene resetslumber2
: Is it really that bad?
lines.zh: : 真有那么糟吗？

lines.en: : I haven’t felt this uncomfortable since you taught me how to masturbate.
lines.zh: : 自从你教我怎么自慰之后，我就没这么不自在了。

lines.en: : See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 懂我意思了吧？

lines.en: : On the bright side...um...we {i}do{/i} all have something in common now. That’s gotta be worth some points, right?
lines.zh: : 往好处想……嗯……我们{i}确实{/i}有共同点了。这总该值几分吧，对吧？

lines.en: scene resetslumber3
: Ayane is right. The purpose of this gathering was not {i}just{/i} so we could observe one another throughout the night, but so we could take it upon ourselves to educate you as well.
lines.zh: : Ayane 说得对。这次聚会的目的{i}不只{/i}是让我们整晚互相观察，也是为了让我们承担起教育你们的责任。

lines.en: : I’m not sure what either of you have been told, but if there are any questions you have about what is going on, now is the best time to ask them.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们俩听说了什么，但如果你们对正在发生的事有任何疑问，现在是问的最佳时机。

lines.en: : And I say that fully aware that there is a very high likelihood neither one of you will remember any of it very shortly.
lines.zh: : 我说这话时也完全清楚，你们俩很可能很快就会把这些忘得一干二净。

lines.en: : You, uhh...you’ve been doin’ this the longest, right? That’s how {i}he{/i} made it sound, at least.
lines.zh: : 你，呃……你干这个最久，对吧？至少{i}他{/i}说得像是这么回事。

lines.en: : That is correct. I have the most experience and Ayane has the least.
lines.zh: : 没错。我经验最多，Ayane 最少。

lines.en: : And...it ain’t just memories that are bein’ fucked with? It’s actually the world?
lines.zh: : 而且……被搞乱的不只是记忆？是真的这个世界？

lines.en: : I’d say it’s “time” rather than the world itself as the world {i}does{/i} seem to be changing with each passing loop.
lines.zh: : 我会说是「时间」，而不是世界本身，毕竟世界{i}确实{/i}似乎在随着每一次循环而变化。

lines.en: : This is evidenced by the sinkhole where Kumon-mi Academy once stood, as well as the many new businesses that have popped up as the years have gone by.
lines.zh: : 证据就是 Kumon-mi 学园曾经所在的地方变成了天坑，以及这些年里冒出来的许多新店铺。

lines.en: scene resetslumber4
: And that shit ain’t gonna go back to normal after the whole “apocalypse” thing blows over?
lines.zh: : 那等「末日」那套闹完了，这些破事也不会恢复正常？

lines.en: : If it were going to go back to “normal,” it would have happened already. The destruction of that school and subsequent integration of all of their students into {i}ours{/i} is something brand new to even me.
lines.zh: : 如果它会恢复「正常」，早就恢复了。那所学校的毁灭、以及随后他们所有学生并入{i}我们{/i}学校，连对我来说都是全新的事。

lines.en: : So, basically...we’re all just stuck as freshmen and everything else is still changin’ normally?
lines.zh: : 所以基本上……我们都卡在高一，其他一切照常变化？

lines.en: : That is more or less the case, yes.
lines.zh: : 大致就是这么回事，对。

lines.en: : Damn. Now I really wish I was here for that two-month gap between Halloween and Christmas. No point in goin’ back to school if I can’t ever get out.
lines.zh: : 该死。现在我真希望万圣节到圣诞节之间那两个月的空白我也在场。反正永远毕不了业，回去上学也没意义。

lines.en: scene resetslumber5
: Two-month gap?
lines.zh: : 两个月的空白？

lines.en: : Yeah. Did that shit not happen to you? Figured you were in the same boat since you got dragged here as well.
lines.zh: : 对。你没赶上那事？我以为你跟我们是同一条船，毕竟你也被拖来了。

lines.en: : I did not sense anything abnormal about the last two months. What does this “gap” entail, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我没感觉到过去两个月有什么异常。这个「空白」具体指什么？

lines.en: : The rest of us jumped directly from the Dorm Wars closing ceremony to Christmas Eve. None of us have any memories of what happened in between.
lines.zh: : 我们其他人直接从宿舍大战的闭幕式跳到了平安夜。中间发生了什么，我们谁都没有记忆。

lines.en: : To be fair, we can’t be 100%% certain that Tsuneyo’s memories of this time frame are reliable. There are plenty examples of real memories being swapped out for false ones.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我们不能 100%% 确定 Tsuneyo 对这段时间的记忆是可靠的。真实的记忆被替换成虚假记忆的例子有很多。

lines.en: scene resetslumber6
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : You tellin’ me that I ain’t just gotta worry about not rememberin’ shit now...but that some of the shit I {i}do{/i} remember isn’t even legit?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我现在不只要担心什么都记不住……还得担心我{i}记得{/i}的一些事根本不是真的？

lines.en: : Possibly. But seeing as I’m not at all close with you, I’d have no way of knowing which memories of yours are “legit” or not.
lines.zh: : 有可能。不过鉴于我跟你一点也不熟，我无从知道你的哪些记忆是「真的」。

lines.en: : This sort of thing is typically most prevalent directly after the world is reset as events directly correlating to it are removed from the minds of those involved and replaced with more traditionally logical scenarios.
lines.zh: : 这类事通常在世界刚重置之后最为普遍：与之直接相关的事件会从相关者的脑海中被抹去，换成更符合常理的情节。

lines.en: : In my opinion, the most ideal scenario right now and what I imagine would actually provide us {i}some{/i} form of answer, is one of you making it through the reset while the other does not.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，眼下最理想、也最可能给我们{i}某种{/i}答案的情形，是你们其中一个撑过了重置，而另一个没有。

lines.en: : Ain’t that just askin’ for somebody to be killed, though? The fuck does it even mean to be a human being if your memories ain’t even yours?
lines.zh: : 可那不就等于盼着有人去死吗？如果你的记忆都不属于你自己，那做人还有他妈什么意义？

lines.en: : I may have believed that a long time ago. Now, I just see it as another system in place to prevent this world from deviating from its given path.
lines.zh: : 很久以前我也许会这么想。现在，我只把它看成另一套用来防止这个世界偏离既定轨道的系统。

lines.en: : Do you have any more questions?
lines.zh: : 你们还有别的问题吗？

lines.en: : I have one.
lines.zh: : 我有一个。

lines.en: scene resetslumber7
: Oh, right. I suppose you would as you’re still mostly lacking in experience. What’s your question, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我想你会有的，毕竟你还基本没什么经验。你问吧，Ayane？

lines.en: : My question is...shouldn’t we be hoping that {i}everybody{/i} makes it through instead of just one person?
lines.zh: : 我的问题是……我们不该希望{i}所有人{/i}都撑过去吗，而不是只有一个人？

lines.en: : While that may be more {i}fun and heartwarming,{/i} it doesn’t {i}teach{/i} us anything. We did not call this meeting to establish a big, happy, eternal family — we called it to get to the bottom of this. To {i}learn.{/i}
lines.zh: : 虽然那样更{i}有趣、更暖心{/i}，但它{i}教{/i}不了我们任何东西。我们开这个会不是为了组建一个其乐融融的永恒大家庭——我们开这个会是为了把这事查清楚。为了{i}学习{/i}。

lines.en: : But why can’t we-
lines.zh: : 可是我们为什么不能-

lines.en: scene resetslumber8
: Let me explain something to you, Ayane. And to the rest of you as well since I don’t really mind you learning things about me that I know won’t stick.
lines.zh: : 让我跟你说清楚，Ayane。也跟你们其他人说清楚，反正我不介意你们了解到我一些我知道留不下来的事。

lines.en: : I am {i}tired{/i} of being stuck in this body.
lines.zh: : 我{i}受够了{/i}被困在这具身体里。

lines.en: : When that happens, you should train. Become a better you.
lines.zh: : 发生那种事的时候，你该去训练。成为更好的自己。

lines.en: : That is not what I mean. I want to {i}grow up.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。我想的是{i}长大{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ve experienced the first year of high school for so long that I can’t even estimate how much time has {i}actually{/i} passed anymore.
lines.zh: : 我经历高一已经经历了太久，久到我甚至估算不出到底{i}真的{/i}过去了多少时间。

lines.en: : So while I’m sure that eternal life and eternal youth may sound great to some of you...for others, it’s a prison.
lines.zh: : 所以，虽然我确信永生和永葆青春对你们某些人听起来很棒……对另一些人来说，那就是一座监狱。

lines.en: : Even the things you love the most become easy to despise when you’re unable to escape them.
lines.zh: : 就连你最爱的东西，在无法逃离的时候也会变得容易令人憎恶。

lines.en: : So, no. I {i}don’t{/i} think we should be hoping for more people to {i}make it through.{/i} Not when that means damning them to a life of perpetual falsehood.
lines.zh: : 所以，不。我{i}不{/i}认为我们应该指望更多人{i}撑过去{/i}。尤其当那意味着把他们判给一个充满永久谎言的人生时。

lines.en: : I didn’t really...think of it like that...
lines.zh: : 我真的没有……那样想过……

lines.en: : It is clear to me that you have done this for a very long time...but your memories alone are not enough to surpass those of others in terms of reliability.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚你干这个已经很久了……但单凭你的记忆，在可靠性上并不足以胜过别人。

lines.en: scene resetslumber9
: Huh?
: What I mean to say is that being caught in a perpetual cycle may have created this jaded and stubborn outlook you have.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，长期陷在这个循环里，可能造就了你现在这种疲惫又固执的看法。

lines.en: : Even my father grew tired of noodles at one point.
lines.zh: : 就连我父亲也曾一度吃腻了拉面。

lines.en: : Why should everyone trust you just because you say you’ve been around the longest when you’ve already admitted to the possibility of false memories being swapped in for the truth?
lines.zh: : 凭什么大家要因为你自称待得最久就相信你，何况你自己都承认过，真实的记忆有可能被虚假的记忆替换？

lines.en: : That...no, hold on.
lines.zh: : 那……不，等等。

lines.en: : You are no more reliable than I am...but you want to be seen that way. And the people who want trust the most are, more often than not, the ones who are not meant to be trusted.
lines.zh: : 你并不比我更可靠……可你想被当成那样。而最渴望信任的人，往往恰恰是最不该被信任的人。

lines.en: scene resetslumber10
: R-Regardless of whether or not anyone trusts me, which I really don’t care about, I still think it would be best to approach all of this with an air of skepticism.
lines.zh: : 不-不管别人信不信我，反正我也真不在乎，我依然认为，最好带着怀疑的态度来面对这一切。

lines.en: : Despite my tendency to do so, I understand that it is typically impossible to predict the future. What {i}is{/i} possible is creating objectives or goals or...places you want to end up.
lines.zh: : 尽管我天生如此，我也明白未来通常是无法预测的。{i}能{/i}做的是设定目标、目的，或者……你想抵达的地方。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is what I’m doing right now. So please forgive me if I wind up leaving you out of those places if I’m unable to make enough room for you.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}才是我现在在做的事。所以，如果我没能腾出足够的空间把你算进去，请原谅我。

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, this shit hurts my brain. But damn is it entertaining.
lines.zh: : 说句实话，这玩意儿真他妈烧脑。不过操，确实挺有意思。

lines.en: scene resetslumber11
: Do you have anything to add, Sensei? You’ve been pretty quiet this whole time.
lines.zh: : 你有什么要补充的吗，Sensei？你从头到尾都挺安静的。

lines.en: : Huh? Me? What?
lines.zh: : 哈？我？什么？

lines.en: : If you’re blackin’ out again, least you’re doin’ it here. Got four whole people to hold you down this time and, much as I hate to admit it, Tsuneyo’s a Hell of a lot stronger than I am.
lines.zh: : 如果你又要断片，至少这次是在这儿断。这回有四个人能按住你，而且虽然我很不想承认，Tsuneyo 可比我壮多了。

lines.en: : So am I, but we can ignore that if it makes you feel better.
lines.zh: : 我也一样，不过要是这能让你好受点，我们可以忽略这个。

lines.en: : Say that again and I’ll beat your ass so bad you’ll be {i}hopin’{/i} to get your memory wiped.
lines.zh: : 你再说一遍，我就把你打得{i}盼着{/i}记忆被抹掉。

lines.en: : I’m not blacking out. I’m fine. Just...feeling a little out of it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我没有断片。我没事。只是……有点恍惚，我想。

lines.en: scene resetslumber12
: Out of it...how? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 恍惚……怎么个恍惚？你什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m probably just tired. In fact, does anyone want coffee? I saw that Ayane brought some over and, if we’re really going to be staying up all night, we’re going to need it.
lines.zh: : 我大概只是累了。话说，有人要咖啡吗？我看到 Ayane 带了一些过来，如果真要熬通宵，我们需要它。

lines.en: scene resetslumber13
: There’s soda and hot chocolate too if anyone wants any. I might be banned from using my credit card, but there was still plenty of stuff at my house I was able to grab before coming here.
lines.zh: : 还有汽水和热可可，谁要都行。虽然我的信用卡被停了，但来这儿之前我从家里还是能顺到不少东西。

lines.en: scene black
: I suppose I’ll have some coffee. The last time I stayed up all night was- well, actually...it was Christmas. But before that, it was a long time.
lines.zh: : 我来点咖啡吧。我上一次通宵是——嗯，其实……是圣诞节。不过在那之前，是很久以前了。

lines.en: : I will make myself tea as I also brought some things from home. But if it is okay with everyone, I would like to return a phone call first. It should not take very long at all.
lines.zh: : 我自己泡茶，因为我也从家里带了些东西。不过如果大家不介意，我想先回个电话。应该不会太久。

lines.en: : I can make your tea. Just tell me where you-
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你泡茶。你告诉我东西在哪-

lines.en: : I refuse to let a man touch any of my beverages. I have heard too many horrible stories.
lines.zh: : 我绝不让男人碰我的任何饮品。我听过的可怕故事太多了。

lines.en: : Smart move. I’ll hold off on coffee for now on account of both that and the fact that I ain’t really tired yet.
lines.zh: : 明智之举。那我先不喝咖啡了，一来是因为这个，二来我也还没真觉得困。

lines.en: : Go ahead and make your call, Tsuneyo. We’ll wait for you to come back before we talk about anything important again.
lines.zh: : 去打电话吧，Tsuneyo。我们会等你回来再谈重要的事。

lines.en: : Thank you for understanding. Please excuse me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们理解。失陪一下。

lines.en: scene resetslumber14
I make my way over to the coffee machine (Which I have yet to use in the short time of me “owning” this apartment) and, between the scoops of grounds, attempt to make sense of the way I’m feeling.
lines.zh: 我走到咖啡机旁（这公寓我「拥有」的时间这么短，还没用过它），在一勺勺咖啡粉之间，试图理清自己的感受。

lines.en: It’s all wrong- even by my standards, which have never been {i}right{/i} to begin with.
lines.zh: 全都错了——即便以我的标准来看，而我的标准从来就没{i}对{/i}过。

lines.en: Is this really going to work?
lines.zh: 这真的能成吗？

lines.en: If what Maya says about watching everyone disappear is true...do I even have it in myself to do that?
lines.zh: 如果 Maya 说的看着所有人消失是真的……我真有那个心力去承受吗？

lines.en: These girls are important to me.
lines.zh: 这些女孩对我很重要。

lines.en: If they’re going to hurt, it should be {i}my{/i} fault. Not the fault of some cosmic horror descending from an unimaginable Heaven and wreaking havoc on their fragile bodies.
lines.zh: 如果她们要受伤，那该是{i}我{/i}的错。而不是某个从不可想象的天界降临、在她们脆弱的身体上肆虐的宇宙恐怖的错。

lines.en: Those bodies are {i}mine{/i} to break.
lines.zh: 那些身体是{i}我{/i}的，该由我来弄坏。

lines.en: That fragility is {i}mine{/i} to take advantage of.
lines.zh: 那份脆弱是{i}我{/i}的，该由我来利用。

lines.en: And yet...
lines.zh: 然而……

lines.en: I’m making them coffee.
lines.zh: 我在给她们煮咖啡。

lines.en: : Ponytail, you got a sec? Have another question for you.
lines.zh: : 马尾辫，有空吗？还有个问题想问你。

lines.en: : The amount of secs I have will not expire until the current cycle comes to an end. Feel free to ask whatever it is you’re concerned about. Just know that I don’t have {i}all{/i} of the answers.
lines.zh: : 我的空闲在当前循环结束之前不会过期。你担心什么尽管问。只是要知道，我没有{i}所有{/i}答案。

lines.en: : I’m fine with stayin’ up and shit but, like...how will I know when this apocalypse business starts? What should I be on the lookout for?
lines.zh: : 熬夜什么的我无所谓，不过……我怎么知道末日什么时候开始？我该留意什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you’ll know. And if you get too tired, it’s fine to take a nap. We can sleep in shifts.
lines.zh: : 哦，你会知道的。要是太累了，打个盹也没关系。我们可以轮班睡。

lines.en: : The important thing is that we all stay in one place so that, should the world begin to collapse, we won’t need to go far to find one another.
lines.zh: : 重要的是我们都待在同一个地方，这样万一世界开始崩塌，我们不用跑太远就能找到彼此。

lines.en: : We don’t know that for sure, though...I wasn’t able to see you at all last time.
lines.zh: : 不过我们也不确定……上次我完全看不到你。

lines.en: : No...you weren’t.
lines.zh: : 对……你看不到。

lines.en: scene resetslumber15
: But {i}he{/i} was.
lines.zh: : 但{i}他{/i}看得到。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s the key?
lines.zh: : 也许那就是关键？

lines.en: : Only one way of knowing, I guess. I’ll try not to get too scared this time.
lines.zh: : 大概只有一种办法能知道。这次我尽量不那么害怕。

lines.en: : And I’ll try to...not get in the fuckin’ way or whatever. This shit’s so weird.
lines.zh: : 而我尽量……不去碍事什么的。这破事太怪了。

lines.en: There are over nineteen different ways to brew coffee.
lines.zh: 煮咖啡有十九种以上的方法。

lines.en: I will now tell you about them.
lines.zh: 现在我来讲给你听。

lines.en: The first is the espresso machine.
lines.zh: 第一种是意式咖啡机。

lines.en: Anyone who knows anything about coffee knows what an espresso machine is – they’ve been keeping us caffeinated since 1901.
lines.zh: 懂点咖啡的人都知道意式咖啡机是什么——从 1901 年起，它们就一直在为我们提供咖啡因。

lines.en: Today they come in various shapes and sizes, with loads of features and gimmicks.
lines.zh: 如今它们形状大小各异，功能和花招一大堆。

lines.en: Don’t get confused by flash machines though because the basics are the same.
lines.zh: 不过别被那些花哨的机器弄晕，因为基本原理是一样的。

lines.en: Pressurized water is pushed through a chamber/puck of finely ground coffee beans, through a filter, resulting in what we call a shot of espresso.
lines.zh: 加压的水被推过一腔／一块精细研磨的咖啡粉，再穿过滤网，萃取出我们称之为一份意式浓缩的东西。

lines.en: Don’t have a few hundred bucks to spend on an espresso machine, but still looking for that espresso-shot-like-kick that comes from a pressurized brew? The Moka-Pot is the next best thing.
lines.zh: 花不起几百美元买意式机，却仍想要加压萃取带来的那种浓缩般的一击？摩卡壶是次优之选。

lines.en: The magic behind the Moka pot is in its 3 chambered brew process. Water in the bottom chamber boils, and the steam causes pressure that pushes water up through the coffee grounds into the top chamber.​
lines.zh: 摩卡壶的魔力在于它的三段式腔体萃取过程。底部腔室的水沸腾，蒸汽产生压力，把水推着穿过咖啡粉进入顶部腔室。

lines.en: The AeroPress has a cult following among the traveling coffee community, and it looks more like a science project rather than a coffee brewer.
lines.zh: AeroPress 在旅行咖啡圈里有一群狂热追随者，它看起来更像个科学实验装置，而不是咖啡器具。

lines.en: But, if you ask me, it’s the best thing that has ever happened to coffee. And many people say it brews the best coffee they’ve ever tasted.
lines.zh: 不过，你要是问我，它是咖啡界发生过的最好的事。很多人说它煮出了他们喝过最好的咖啡。

lines.en: The French press is the unofficial mascot of home brewed coffee.
lines.zh: 法压壶是家庭冲泡咖啡的非官方吉祥物。

lines.en: It’s been steeping coffee in households since before your grandparents were born, and it has a very loyal, cult following among the home barista community.
lines.zh: 在你祖父母出生之前，它就一直在各家各户里浸泡咖啡，在家庭咖啡师圈子里有着非常忠实的狂热追随者。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 但为什么呢？

lines.en: It’s likely thanks to multiple reasons, but our money is on the fact that its super easy to use, can be picked up for pocket change (almost) and produces a brew with a distinct taste and feel like no other method.
lines.zh: 可能有多种原因，不过我们把赌注押在这点上：它超级好用，（几乎）花点零钱就能买到，而且能煮出一种风味和口感都独一无二、别无二家的咖啡。

lines.en: A relatively new invention (est. 2010) the SoftBrew has been dubbed ‘primitive yet high tech’.
lines.zh: 相对较新的发明（约 2010 年），SoftBrew 被称为「原始却高科技」。

lines.en: I’m not sure what the fuck that means, but if I were to describe the SoftBrew in simple terms, I would say “it’s like a French press, but easier.”
lines.zh: 我不知道那他妈是什么意思，不过如果要我用简单的话描述 SoftBrew，我会说「它就像法压壶，但更简单」。

lines.en: The idea of instant coffee is great – it comes in a small jar so you can take it anywhere. Just add hot water.
lines.zh: 速溶咖啡的创意很棒——装在小罐子里，随身带着走。只需加热水。

lines.en: There’s just one major problem — it fucking blows. So we’re not gonna talk about that one.
lines.zh: 只有一个大问题——它他妈难喝得要命。所以我们不谈这个。

lines.en: Making coffee with a siphon pot is unique as it comes.
lines.zh: 用虹吸壶煮咖啡独一无二。

lines.en: It’s a combination of brewing methods: a full immersion brew (as your coffee goes into the water) but also uses siphon action to create a great tasting cup.
lines.zh: 它是多种冲泡方式的结合：全浸泡式萃取（咖啡直接进水），同时又利用虹吸作用做出一杯味道很棒的咖啡。

lines.en: It’s not a simple way to brew coffee, in fact, it requires an enormous amount of effort and process, so you won’t want to use it daily (unless you’ve got nothing else to do).
lines.zh: 这不是一种简单的煮法，事实上它需要大量的精力和工序，所以你不会想天天用它（除非你闲得没事干）。

lines.en: The percolator is nothing new or cutting edge in the world of coffee. If you’ve been to a bland looking diner somewhere in the Northern Hemisphere, chances are you’ve drunk percolated coffee.
lines.zh: 渗滤壶在咖啡界不算什么新鲜或前沿的东西。如果你去过北半球某家看着寡淡的餐厅，你多半喝过渗滤咖啡。

lines.en: Rumor has it that there are people out there who actually enjoy percolated coffee, but the person who told me that was also trapped inside a jar of peanut butter.
lines.zh: 有传言说真有人喜欢渗滤咖啡，不过告诉我这事的那个人，当时也被困在一罐花生酱里。

lines.en: The next method is the Chemex brewer, which looks like a weird vase.
lines.zh: 下一种方法是 Chemex 滤杯，它看起来像个奇怪的花瓶。

lines.en: The primary benefit of using a Chemex over other drippers is capacity.
lines.zh: 与其他手冲器具相比，Chemex 的主要优势是容量。

lines.en: You can easily make 3 or 4 cups in one go, rather than 1 or 2, meaning it’s a crowd pleaser when your homies are around.
lines.zh: 你可以一次轻松做 3 到 4 杯，而不是 1 到 2 杯，这意味着朋友在的时候它很讨喜。

lines.en: In fact, you can buy a 10-cup Chemex Vase that takes 50 ounces of water. It’s an entertainer’s best friend.
lines.zh: 事实上，你还能买到能装 50 盎司水的 10 杯装 Chemex 花瓶。它是待客的最佳拍档。

lines.en: Sometimes, I masturbate in front of the window in hopes that someone will see me.
lines.zh: 有时候，我对着窗户自慰，希望有人能看到我。

lines.en: I’ll be honest: when I first got my V60 dripper I didn’t have too much faith in it – it just seemed so simple compared to other pour over coffee brewing systems. That week I learned never to make assumptions.
lines.zh: 说实话：刚拿到 V60 滤杯时我对它没什么信心——比起其他手冲系统，它显得太简单了。那一周我学会了永远不要下结论。

lines.en: The Hario v60 is a simple yet brilliant way to brew coffee – its small and light, meaning you can take it just about anywhere, and it makes a damn good cup of Joseph.
lines.zh: Hario V60 是一种简单却绝妙的煮咖啡方式——它小巧轻便，意味着你几乎可以带着它去任何地方，而且它能煮出一杯该死的约瑟夫。

lines.en: The Kalita Wave Dripper is the arch-enemy of the Hario V60 – and it’s giving the V60 a good run for its money.
lines.zh: Kalita Wave 滤杯是 Hario V60 的死敌——而且它正让 V60 疲于应付。

lines.en: Like the V60, the Kalita Wave involves a simple cone shaped dripping system, however, its flat-bed (as opposed to the v60’s conical shape) means longer dwell times and less room for error.
lines.zh: 和 V60 一样，Kalita Wave 用的是简单的锥形滴滤系统，不过它的平底（相对于 V60 的锥形）意味着更长的浸泡时间和更小的失误空间。

lines.en: The Vietnamese dripper (also called a ‘Phin’) is a single cup dripper that takes 4-5 minutes to brew, meaning it’s the perfect accomplice for solo coffee drinkers who want more time to party.
lines.zh: 越南滴滤壶（也叫「Phin」）是一种单杯滴滤器，冲泡需要 4 到 5 分钟，这让它成为想多些时间开派对的独饮咖啡客的完美搭档。

lines.en: Unlike some of the above drippers, this method of brewing does not call for much skill or fancy pouring style. It’s about as easy as they come; just pour in your water and wait.
lines.zh: 不像上面某些滴滤器，这种煮法不需要太多技巧或花哨的注水手法。它简单到了极点；倒进水，然后等。

lines.en: The Melitta Ready Set Joe dripper is the most convenient option on the market – perfect for camping fanatics who still love a decent cup of Joseph.
lines.zh: Melitta Ready Set Joe 滤杯是市场上最方便的选择——非常适合仍然爱喝一杯像样约瑟夫的露营狂热者。

lines.en: It’s a simple plastic dripping cone that brews coffee in a flash.
lines.zh: 它是一个简单的塑料滴滤锥，能迅速煮好咖啡。

lines.en: You won’t get the same quality brew that you’ll get with other drippers, however, its price tag and portability means it’s a favorite among campers and travelers.​
lines.zh: 你得不到其他滴滤器那样的品质，不过它的价格和便携性让它成为露营者和旅行者的心头好。

lines.en: The Bee House is a Japanese pour over brewer that is getting a great deal of attention in the coffee world – likely because it’s easy to use and looks really sexy.
lines.zh: Bee House 是一款日式手冲器具，在咖啡界颇受关注——大概是因为它好用，而且看起来真的很性感。

lines.en: It’s worth mentioning that the learning curve is more forgiving than the Hario V60 or the Kalita Wave, meaning it’s a great way to get your feet wet in the world of pour over coffee.
lines.zh: 值得一提的是，它的学习曲线比 Hario V60 或 Kalita Wave 更宽容，这意味着它是踏入手冲咖啡世界的绝佳入门方式。

lines.en: Tsuneyo sure is taking a long time out there.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 在外面待的时间可真长。

lines.en: The Clever Dripper looks like just any other pour over dripper, but on closer inspection you’ll notice that the Clever Dripper is a cross between a steeping and pour over brewer.
lines.zh: Clever Dripper 看起来跟其他手冲滤杯没什么两样，但仔细看你会发现，它是浸泡式和手冲式的结合体。

lines.en: What sets this lil’ dude apart from the rest of the dripper family is its clever little valve that stops your brew draining into your cup/vessel until you activate it.
lines.zh: 让这个小家伙在滴滤家族里与众不同的，是它那个巧妙的小阀门——在你启动它之前，它会阻止咖啡液流进你的杯子／容器。

lines.en: If you haven’t heard of cold drip coffee you must be a fucking idiot. That or you’ve been hiding under a rock for the past few years.
lines.zh: 如果你没听说过冷滴咖啡，那你一定是个他妈的白痴。要么就是过去几年一直躲在石头底下。

lines.en: Cold brew is one of the most popular caffeine infused innovations of our time – and no, we are not talking about iced coffee.
lines.zh: 冷萃是我们这个时代最受欢迎的含咖啡因创新之一——不，我们说的不是冰咖啡。

lines.en: In a nutshell, it’s made by slowly dripping cold filtered water through your fresh grinds for a long period – often 10 hours or more. Enough time to kidnap someone or repair a section of a broken fence.
lines.zh: 简而言之，它是用冷的过滤水慢慢滴过新鲜研磨的咖啡粉、历时很长制成的——通常 10 小时甚至更久。足够你去绑架一个人，或者修好一段破损的栅栏。

lines.en: Derived from cold brew coffee, nitro coffee is the newest kid on the block in the coffee world, and you can expect to hear a lot more about it in the future.
lines.zh: 氮气咖啡从冷萃咖啡衍生而来，是咖啡界的新秀，未来你肯定会听到更多关于它的消息。

lines.en: As the name suggests, it's cold brewed coffee, pumped full of nitrogen, which affects the taste and the texture in a very, very nice way.
lines.zh: 顾名思义，它是冷萃咖啡，注入了满满的氮气，以一种非常、非常美妙的方式影响口感和质地。

lines.en: The result is similar to a cold brew coffee but crisper, a little sweeter and it looks like a pint of Guinness — a beverage that does not exist in Kumon-mi since we are blocked off from the rest of the world.
lines.zh: 成果类似于冷萃咖啡，但更清爽、稍微更甜，而且看起来像一品脱健力士——这种饮料在 Kumon-mi 并不存在，因为我们与外界隔绝。

lines.en: Aren’t you excited to know so much about coffee now?
lines.zh: 现在知道这么多咖啡知识，是不是很兴奋？

lines.en: Let's learn some more.
lines.zh: 我们再多学一点。

lines.en: Cowboy coffee is the oldest known method of brewing coffee.
lines.zh: 牛仔咖啡是已知最古老的煮咖啡方法。

lines.en: It’s outdated, but it works, and you don’t need much to make it happen.
lines.zh: 它过时了，但管用，而且不需要什么就能做成。

lines.en: Commonly used around campsites where nobody has bothered to pack any coffee making gear, all you’ll need is a flame and a saucepan.
lines.zh: 通常在露营地用，那里没人费心带咖啡器具，你只需要一团火和一口锅。

lines.en: In a nutshell: fill your pot with water, bring it to a boil, throw in your ground coffee, remove it from the heat and let it brew for a few minutes.
lines.zh: 简而言之：锅里装水，烧开，扔进咖啡粉，离火，让它泡几分钟。

lines.en: Once the grounds settle to the bottom of the pot, you can pour your coffee into your mug, slowly and gently. Nothing fancy required.
lines.zh: 等咖啡粉沉到锅底，你就可以缓慢而轻柔地把咖啡倒进杯子里。不需要什么花招。

lines.en: From 1299, the Ottoman Empire ruled Turkey for an impressively long stint, and strong Turkish coffee played a significant role in fueling their endurance.
lines.zh: 从 1299 年起，奥斯曼帝国统治土耳其的时间长得惊人，而浓烈的土耳其咖啡在支撑他们的耐力上扮演了重要角色。

lines.en: There’s a very good chance that I made up that last fact, however, you can be sure that (A) Turkish coffee packs a punch, and (B) It’s been enjoyed around the world for a very long time.
lines.zh: 我最后那个事实很可能是编的，不过你可以确信两点：(A) 土耳其咖啡劲很大，(B) 它在全世界被人享用了很久。

lines.en: Brewing Turkish coffee seems easy, but with like most brew methods, there’s skill in doing it right. Learn the skills by reading a guide or something.
lines.zh: 煮土耳其咖啡看起来简单，但和大多数冲泡方式一样，做好它需要技巧。看看指南什么的学学技巧吧。

lines.en: The most common way involves a Turkish coffee pot, water and very finely ground coffee beans.
lines.zh: 最常见的方法需要一把土耳其咖啡壶、水和磨得极细的咖啡豆。

lines.en: You’ll simmer the brew a number of times (2-3 times) and end up with a brew that you’ll love or hate: strong but exceptional tasting with a thick foam on top.
lines.zh: 你要把咖啡煮开几次（2 到 3 次），最后得到一杯你要么爱死、要么恨死的咖啡：浓烈却味道出众，上面浮着一层厚厚的泡沫。

lines.en: Congratulations. Now you are the coffee expert.
lines.zh: 恭喜。现在你是咖啡专家了。

lines.en: scene resetslumber16
: I’ll get it.
lines.zh: : 我去开。

lines.en: scene resetslumber17
: Hey. How was your phone call?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你电话打得怎么样？

lines.en: : It was fine. Apologies for locking myself out of the room. I am not used to doors that do that automatically.
lines.zh: : 挺好的。抱歉把自己锁在门外了。我不习惯会自动锁上的门。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I boiled some water for you if you want to make your own tea. I solemnly swear that I didn’t drug it either.
lines.zh: : 没事。我给你烧了点水，你想泡自己的茶可以用。我郑重发誓我也没在里面下药。

lines.en: : I thank you for taking the time to both boil the water and not place any drugs in it, but I regret to inform you that I will no longer be able to stay here tonight.
lines.zh: : 感谢你花时间烧水、又没有往里面下任何药，但我很遗憾地通知你，我今晚不能再待在这里了。

lines.en: : What? Why not?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : A neighbor has reported a strange smell coming from Tojo Ramen. I must return home to investigate this and make sure that everything is in order.
lines.zh: : 有邻居报告 Tojo Ramen 传来一股奇怪的味道。我必须回家查看，确保一切正常。

lines.en: : It is highly probable that the power has gone out once again and that food is beginning to spoil.
lines.zh: : 很可能是又停电了，食物开始变质。

lines.en: : However, if it is something as serious as a gas leak, please be prepared to never see me again as I may explode.
lines.zh: : 不过如果是煤气泄漏那么严重的事，请做好再也见不到我的心理准备，因为我可能会爆炸。

lines.en: : What about your father? If there’s a gas leak, shouldn’t he be the number-one priority?
lines.zh: : 那你父亲呢？如果是煤气泄漏，他不该是第一优先吗？

lines.en: : I am worried about him, yes. Which is precisely why I must return.
lines.zh: : 我很担心他，是的。这正是我必须回去的原因。

lines.en: : I apologize for the inconvenience. But if the world does not end and you reconvene tomorrow, I’d be happy to join you once more.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉带来不便。但如果世界没有终结、你们明天再聚，我很乐意再次加入。

lines.en: : That’s fine since it’s an emergency and everything...the others are just going to be a little disappointed since they had to pull a bunch of strings to make sure this happened.
lines.zh: : 既然是紧急情况，那也没办法……其他人只是会有点失望，毕竟她们费了不少功夫才让这事成行。

lines.en: scene resetslumber18
: Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...keeping Ami away from us isn’t really an easy task, you know.
lines.zh: : 是啊……让 Ami 离我们远点，可不是件容易的事，你知道的。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : Oh well. Get going, then. I’ll be the one to break the bad news. Wouldn’t want {i}you{/i} having to upset them and I’m already pretty much used to it.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就走吧。坏消息由我来传达。我可不想让{i}你{/i}去惹她们难过，而且我已经差不多习惯了。

lines.en: : I’m sure they will be fine.
lines.zh: : 我相信她们会没事的。

lines.en: : They seem to be having a great deal of fun right now.
lines.zh: : 她们现在看起来玩得挺开心的。

lines.en: scene resetslumber19
: Yeah, they’re getting along much-
lines.zh: : 是啊，她们相处得-

lines.en: : Please excuse me.
lines.zh: : 失陪了。

lines.en: : Thank you again for the invitation.
lines.zh: : 再次感谢你的邀请。

lines.en: I’m fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: I’m fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。
